field_principles.approximation_error_bound: PWA abstraction error must be visible even when zero by exact audit
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal verdict must start with a success prefix unless blocked
field_principles.inference_substrate: exact CPU verifier work must not be confused with live LLM inference
field_principles.kan_pwa_verification_ready: KAN verification claims require trained-KAN exact or bounded evidence
field_principles.locality_bound: locality claims need a numeric bound
field_principles.promotion_decision: controller evidence must not imply model-weight learning
field_principles.tests_or_checks_run: formulaic verifier changes need execution evidence
field_principles.verification_path: implementation or audit path must be explicit
